text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, neostigmine methylsulfate is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 57 vials (15 days on hand) and Corvale General holds 109 vials (28.1 days on hand). The rule‑ranked first option is to buy from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today; its label names no plant we could place.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage records show a prior posting for Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC marked "To Be Discontinued" with an initial posting date of 2026-01-12. The product label on file names Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (FEI 2220525) as the registered manufacturing plant. That plant's most recent FDA inspection (ID 1237333) ended 2024-06-12 and was classified VAI, with the classification known to FDA on 2024-12-16.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs at both sites. No active FDA shortage listing exists. Alternative suppliers are available but their manufacturing plants are unidentified on labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC supply reliability and pricing; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc. as secondary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to assess BE Pharmaceuticals Inc., Camber Pharmaceuticals Inc., and Caplin Steriles Limited for backup contracts; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report changes; requires Pharmacy Director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or dose adjustments at this time.
